705726.name: Binder of Storms
705726.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Expulsion by 0 sec.

705727.name: Disciple of Thorim
705727.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Torrential Wrath by -0.2 sec and increases your hit chance by 2%.

706297.name: Eye of the Tornado
706297.desc: Your damaging critical strikes now refund 5 Static.

706433.name: Power Sphere
706433.desc: Explodes when the Sphere of Power reaches its target.

706434.name: Spheres of Power
706434.desc: Your direct damage dealt now has a 25% chance to summon a Power Sphere that will move towards your target. Can only have 1 Power Sphere up at a time. Power Sphere will redirect its movement towards enemies you cast Stormflow on. Upon reaching the target, it deals cond(gt(SPA, SPN), 697+33+SPA*0.485, 697+33+SPN*0.485) Spellstorm Damage to them and enemies within 5 yds.

706625.name: Unshackle
706625.desc: Depletes 50 Static Transforms your Air Elemental into a more powerful form for 15 seconds, increasing damage dealt by 25% and spell haste by 30%.

706628.name: Everlasting Invigoration
706628.desc: Increases the duration of Invigoration by 5 sec.

706660.name: Raining and Pouring
706660.desc: Increases the critical damage of your Torrential Wrath by 30%.

706681.name: Stormflow Slow Passive
706681.desc: Damage dealt by Stormflow now reduces enemies movement speed by 40% for 1 sec.

707044.name: Storm Alert
707044.desc: Disturb an enemy with a vision of the coming storm, fearing them for 10 sec. Can only affect 1 enemy at a time. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

707046.name: Fusion
707046.desc: Increases the damage of Stormfuse and Arm of Thorim by 3% for each stack of Flux on the target.

707049.name: Flux Arc Precursor
707049.desc: Arcane Damage dealt echoes to enemies affected by Flux for 10% of the total damage.

707053.name: Altered Course
707053.desc: Casting Discharge now increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

707054.name: Jolt
707054.desc: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of Electrocute by 10%.

707055.name: Fulmination
707055.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Call Lightning by 15% against targets affected by your Volt.

707056.name: Amping Up
707056.desc: Your Volt can now critically strike.

707204.name: Storm Barrier
707204.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Lightning Cage by -30 sec and its movement speed slow reduction on you by 25%.

707365.name: Overload Mechanical
707365.desc: Overload all Mechanical enemies in a target area, disorienting them for 40 sec (8 sec vs players).

707543.name: Flurry
707543.desc: Depletes 10 Static Command your Air Elemental, causing its next instance of damage to unleash a flurry of air on your target, dealing 763 + 140% nature SP Nature Damage over 21 seconds, and reducing their resistances by 75, and increasing their Magic Damage taken by -2%.

707546.name: Enveloping Winds
707546.desc: Casting Gale now causes your Air Elemental to cast Gale. Additionally, you now emanate an aura around you, increasing the Armor of party and raid members by 390. Does not stack with similar effects.

707548.name: Air Flow
707548.desc: Reduces the cast time of Aeroblast by -0.3 sec.

707615.name: Tempest Calling
707615.desc: Enhances some of your spells with the power of the wind, tranforming your Conjure Storm into Updraft and Call Lightning into Aeroblast.

707618.name: Lord of Lightning
707618.desc: Storm Ascendance now additionally grants you Lord of Lightning for 20 seconds.

707619.name: Pulse Conversion
707619.desc: Dispelling a magic effect with Stormbreaker now heals you for 3% of your maximum health.

707652.name: Ionic Aura
707652.desc: Increases the maximum mana, Rage, Energy, Focus, and Runic Power of allies within 40 yds by 3%.

707667.name: Passing Wind
707667.desc: Level 20 Passive Increases your spell penetration by -100, scaling with your level.

707719.name: Windrunner
707719.desc: The wind is always at your back, pushing you to move faster, increasing your movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%.

712431.name: Aurat Scripts
712431.desc: Increases the damage gained per stack of Invigoration by 2%.

800014.name: Raging Storm
800014.desc: Increases spell haste by 3%, stacking 10 times.

800098.name: Thunder Ward
800098.desc: Depletes All Static Encase yourself in an electrical shield, removing and making you immune to all physical attacks and spells for 10 seconds. Cannot generate Static for the duration.

800099.name: Ride the Lightning
800099.desc: Depletes 40 Static Infuse yourself with lightning and blink forward a long distance, dealing 548 + 100% SP Nature Damage to all enemies in your path.

800100.name: Lightning Tendrils
800100.desc: Tendrils of lightning shoot out of the caster's chest, lifting them into the air. These lightning tendrils deal 61.8 to 62.8 Nature damage to all enemies around the caster every second.

800227.name: Conjure Storm
800227.desc: Depletes 50 Static Conjure a storm over a target area, instantly dealing 31.046 initial Nature damage to enemies. Deals an additional 60000 Nature damage to the enemies in the area over 12 sec.

800325.name: High Static Screen
800325.desc: Augments the weather for you and other party and raid members within 0yd, making it appear as if you were in Icecrown Glacier.

800692.name: Static Lock
800692.desc: Locks your Static for the next 6 sec, preventing it from increasing or decreasing. Triggering a Supercharge effect while this is active will not deplete your Static.

800925.name: Thunder
800925.desc: Does 132 to 133 additional Spellstorm Damage to the target and their nearby allies, and makes your next spell Instant.

801500.name: Child of the Storm
801500.desc: Allows your Wind Servant's damaging spells to replenish 1% of nearby allies' Maximum Mana instantly, and again every 4 sec for 0. In addition, your Wind Servant will now become Unbound when at 20 Typhoon stacks, increasing its damage done by 100%, Spell Haste by 25%, and giving its damaging spells and attacks a chance to trigger a Lightning Lash, dealing bonus damage and reducing the target's Nature Resistance and Movement Speed for a short time.

801640.name: Summon: Lesser Thunder Orb
801640.desc: Deals 19 Nature Damage at the target location.

801800.name: Launch Orbs
801800.desc: Target an area on the ground and transport all nearby Lightning Orbs to the targetted location.

801802.name: Summon: Thunder Orb
801802.desc: Summon a Thunder Orb at the target location for 16 sec that triggers an Orb Shock and generates 10 Static.

801838.name: Cloudburst
801838.desc: Create a mighty gust of wind that knocks away all nearby enemies.

801839.name: Aeroblast
801839.desc: Depletes 50 Static Crush an enemy with the weight of the winds, dealing 271.782 Nature damage to them and then an additional time for 40% of the damage dealt after 1 sec.

801844.name: Electrocute
801844.desc: Generates 20 Static Electrocute an enemy for 278.27 Nature damage. Only usable on enemies below 35% health.

801845.name: Vortex
801845.desc: Wrap an enemy in fierce winds, dealing 211 Nature Damage and stunning them for 4 sec.

801846.name: Exhale
801846.desc: Exhale a gust of wind in a 15 yd cone in front of you, dealing 109.2 Nature Damage and rooting up to 0 enemies in place for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt this effect. Enemies that cannot be rooted are knocked away instead.

801847.name: Arm of Thorim
801847.desc: Depletes All Static Call down a terrible beam of lightning upon an enemy, dealing 161 + 120% nature SP Nature Damage and stunning them for 1 seconds. Damage and cast time increased based on Static level.

801851.name: Forked Lightning
801851.desc: Shoot lightning at an enemy, dealing cond(gt(SPA, SPN), 50+5.22+SPA*0.42, 50+5.22+SPN*0.642) Nature Damage, bouncing to up to 3 enemies. Generates 5 Static for each enemy struck.

801854.name: Titanstorm
801854.desc: Reduces cooldown of Arm of Thorim by 1.5 sec.

801862.name: Hydraxxian Apprentice
801862.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Conduction by 15%.

801871.name: Thunder Prison Unused
801871.desc: Imprisons the enemy target in a cage of lightning, rooting them in place for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

801872.name: Orb Siphon
801872.desc: Instantly siphon power from all nearby Thunder Orbs, granting you 1 stack of Fist of the Gods for each orb consumed, increasing the damage of your next Arm of Thorim spell by 1500% for each stack. Thunder Orbs are destroyed in the process.

802701.name: Lesser Conjure Storm
802701.desc: Deals an additional 208.2 Nature Damage every 1 sec. Scales with modifiers to Conjure Storm.

802702.name: Thorim's Fury
802702.desc: Become charged with lightning, resetting the cooldown of Body of Lightning, and increasing the damage dealt by Body of Lightning by 1000% for 0. Direct critical strikes will increase the duration of this effect by 1 sec.

803002.name: Tempest
803002.desc: Launch yourself forward up to 100 yards. Generates 10 Static.

803007.name: Thunderflow
803007.desc: Your Lightning Orbs will now follow you, and will deal 25% increased damage.

803008.name: Thunderbringer
803008.desc: Increases spell critical strike chance by 3%.

803102.name: Static
803102.desc: Some spells require Static to be used. While out of combat, your Static will begin to fizzle out.

803555.name: Never Strikes Twice
803555.desc: Deals 50% of the initial damage dealt by Electrocute.

803563.name: Barometric Pressure
803563.desc: Thicken the air around you, slowing the movement speed of enemies by 20% and reducing their casting speed by 20%. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time..

803564.name: Crushing Pressure
803564.desc: Embolden the air around you, increasing the duration of movement impairing, fear, and horrify effects on enemies by 20%. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time..

803565.name: Atmospheric Pressure
803565.desc: Destabilize the air around you, increasing the chance for enemies to be struck by spells by 3% and causing you to generate additional Static on damage taken. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time..

803957.name: Spellcharge
803957.desc: Empowers your next Call Lightning, Arm of Thorim, Crackle, Thunderbolt, Lightning Whip or Stormforge Blast to deal 10% increased damage and have 5% reduced Cooldown, but increases its Cast Time by 5%. This effect lasts for 10 sec, and stacks up to 4 times.

804015.name: Storm Rage
804015.desc: Increases the duration of your Storm Ascendance by 5 sec.

804017.name: Torrential Wrath
804017.desc: Depletes 40 Static Blast an enemy, triggering Conduction and dealing 274.2 Frost damage, scaling with your haste rating.

804018.name: Call of the Wind
804018.desc: Call upon the power of the wind to empower an allied player, restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 30 min. Does not stack with Call of the Storm.

804019.name: Summon: Air Elemental
804019.desc: Call an Air Elemental to aid you in combat that gains a stack of Invigoration whenever it deals damage.

804020.name: Shock
804020.desc: Generates 20 Static Shock an enemy for 38.97 Nature damage, plus an additional 20000% of the initial damage over 1 sec.

804022.name: Blessing of Air
804022.desc: Emanate an aura to all party and raid members within 100 yds increasing their spell haste by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.

804035.name: Tailwind
804035.desc: Depletes 20 Static Tap into the swift winds, increasing your damage by 10% and granting all allied players 5% increased haste for 15 seconds. Does not stack with similar effects.

804036.name: Gale
804036.desc: 3 Charges, 10 sec recharge Generates 20 Static Blast an enemy and up to 2 nearby enemies with a powerful gust of wind for 44 + 42% nature SP Nature Damage.

804037.name: Guiding Winds DEPPRECATED
804037.desc: Siphons 25% of your Air Elemental's health to deplete 15 Static and heal all allies within 30 yds for 84.8 to 85.8, and granting them 20% increased movement speed for 8 sec.

804040.name: Storm Channeling
804040.desc: Increases the chance for Stormcloak to trigger by 10%.

804042.name: Unbound Lightning
804042.desc: Your direct damaging spells now have a 20% chance to cast Shock.

804048.name: Thorim's Rage
804048.desc: Increases your critical damage with Nature spells by an additional 20%.

804050.name: Wind Tunnel
804050.desc: Increases the movement speed of all party and raid members within 20 yds by 60% for 8 sec.

804067.name: Cyclonean Protection
804067.desc: Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks of party members within 20 yds by 15%.

804278.name: Electric Energy
804278.desc: Increases the damage of your Call Lightning and Arm of Thorim by 20%.

804419.name: Stasis
804419.desc: Incapacitate an enemy for 8 sec. Damage taken will interrupt the effect.

804578.name: Mana Channeling
804578.desc: Allows 5% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

804597.name: Binding Shock
804597.desc: Causes Electrocute to apply Flux to the target and the nearest other enemy.

804605.name: Residual Power
804605.desc: Reduces your Magic Damage taken by -10%.

804724.name: Windride
804724.desc: You call upon the wind to bring a friendly party or raid member to your location.

804763.name: Conjure Thunder Ale
804763.desc: Conjures 5 tankards of Weak Thunder Ale, providing the Stormbringer and <his/her> allies with something to drink. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

804826.name: Charge
804826.desc: Charge yourself with electricity, generating 100 Static and increasing your spell haste by 30% for your next cast. Lasts 10 seconds.

804827.name: Thunderous
804827.desc: Level 40 Passive Increases the critical damage of your spells by 150%.

804828.name: Never Strikes Twice?
804828.desc: Your Electrocute now has a 10% chance to strike again.

804830.name: Skyfall
804830.desc: Depletes 40 Static Command your Air Elemental, causing its next instance of damage within 8 seconds to strike an enemy, dealing 1349 + 100% arcane SP Nature Damage and increasing the movement speed of all nearby allies by 30% for 15 seconds.

804833.name: Stormcloak
804833.desc: Cover yourself in a barrier of volatile energy for 15 seconds, causing all attacks against you to have a 25% chance to deal half damage. Stormcloak has a 60% chance to resist dispel effects.

804840.name: Flux
804840.desc: Marks an enemy for 30 sec, causing 5% of single target Nature Damage you deal to enemies within 0 yd of them to also affect them. Stacks 5 times.

804841.name: Fluxblast
804841.desc: Depletes 20 Static Blasts an enemy for 38.4 to 44.4 Arcane damage and adds 3 stacks of Flux to them.

804842.name: Fluxcasting
804842.desc: Fluxblast deals 5% increased damage for every stack of Flux already on the target, and Call Lightning spreads Flux from the target to 0 nearby enemies.

805283.name: Summon Lightning Orb
805283.desc: Conjures a Lightning Orb at the target location, lasting up to 20 sec or until destroyed. Lightning Orbs shock nearby enemies with electricity, dealing Nature Damage.

805288.name: Discharge
805288.desc: Depletes 20 Static Discharge electricity, restoring 15% of your maximum mana and dealing 23.503 Nature damage to enemies in a small area around you.

806016.name: Windpelt
806016.desc: Deals 88.352 Nature Damage to an enemy and then bounces to an additional nearby enemy.

806017.name: Unbound
806017.desc: Damage done increased by 100%. Spell haste increased by 25%. Damage done has a chance to strike the enemy dealing Nature Damage, Slowing them and reducing their nature resistance for 5 sec.

806018.name: Quicken Servant
806018.desc: Empower your Wind Servant for 10 sec, increasing its Spell Haste by 40% and Critical Strike Chance by 12%.

806019.name: Storm Steward
806019.desc: Gives your Wind Servant's Windpelt spell a chance to grant you the Storm's Aid effect for -0.001 sec, reducing the cooldown of your Crackle ability by 20%. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

806098.name: Magic Zap
806098.desc: Dispels 1 harmful magic effect from a friendly target.

806100.name: Fog
806100.desc: Concentrate elemental magic to create an 8 yd wide cloudy barrier at your feet for 8 seconds. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the Fog.

806124.name: Aerodynamics
806124.desc: Depletes 40 Static Envelop party and raid members within 40 yds in magical mist, increasing their attack or spell power by 95 for 15 seconds. Does not stack with similar effects.

806223.name: Razorwind
806223.desc: Destroys any damage absorption effects and damage immunity effects on an enemy.

806242.name: Insulate
806242.desc: Depletes 20 Static Shields an ally's spellcasting for 8 sec, granting immunity to interrupt effects and silence effects, removing any such effects when used.

806307.name: Eye of the Storm
806307.desc: Mark an enemy for 4 seconds. Every 1 sec, enemies near them take cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 11+1.6+SPFR*0.42, 11+1.6+SPN*0.42) Nature Damage. At the end of the duration, enemies near them also take cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 42+0+SPFR*0.64, 42+0+SPN*0.64) Nature Damage and are rooted for 4 seconds.

806371.name: Thunder Surge
806371.desc: Causes Expulsion to knock nearby enemies away on use. Cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.

806394.name: Force Wave
806394.desc: Knocks enemies and Thunder Orbs in a 12yd frontal cone a short distance away from you.

806397.name: Bursting
806397.desc: Increases the stack value of Drowning by 5%.

806398.name: Lightning Core
806398.desc: All of your active Lightning Orbs unleash a burst of lightning, knocking up enemies within 0 yd of them.

806400.name: Deluge
806400.desc: Depletes 50 Static Consumes Conductive Blast up to 6 enemies in the target area, dealing cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 26+2.3+SPFR*0.3, 26+2.3+SPN*0.3) Frost Damage, triggering Conduction and reducing their attack power by -24 for 10 seconds.

806401.name: Storming
806401.desc: Increases the duration of Stormcloud by 10 sec.

806404.name: Orbforce Push
806404.desc: All of your active Lightning Orbs unleash a burst of lightning, knocking away all enemies within 0 yd of them.

806406.name: Drowning
806406.desc: Damage taken from Drown increased by 80% per stack, up to 8 stacks.

806407.name: Drown
806407.desc: Attempt to drown an enemy, dealing cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 74+8.14+SPFR*1, 74+8.14+SPN*1) Frost Damage to them after 8 seconds. While affected, each time you generate a stack of Conductive, you apply a stack of Drowning to the enemy for 8 seconds.

806409.name: Kinetic Energy
806409.desc: Casting a spell that consumes Conductive now grants you a stack of Kinetic Energy.

806412.name: Waterfall
806412.desc: Dealing critical damage now reduces all of your cooldowns by -0.5 sec.

806451.name: Windburst
806451.desc: Blasts the target for 347 to 357 Arcane Damage and Stuns them.

806464.name: Thunder Step
806464.desc: Instantly teleports you to the target Lightning Orb, destroying it in the process.

806480.name: Aerology
806480.desc: Switches you between Wind's Grace and Storm's Fury at will. While Wind's Grace is active, you periodically lose Static, and your Slicing Wind spell further reduces your Static. While Storm's Fury is active, you periodically gain Static, and your Slicing Wind spell further increases your Static.

806482.name: Storm's Fury
806482.desc: Activates Storm's Fury, giving your Nature Damage effects a chance to shock the target for bonus Nature Damage and generate 5 Static. While active you have 10% increased Spell Haste and your Spell Critical Strike Chance is increased by 6%. Only 1 of Storm's Fury or Wind's Grace can be active at a time.

806496.name: Supercharge
806496.desc: Empowers your next spell, activating its Supercharged effect. The cooldown of this spell is reduced by 0% in Thorim's Amusement, 0% in Thorim's Respect, and 75% in Thorim's Favor.

806504.name: Lightning Whip
806504.desc: Conjure a whip of lightning tendrils and slam it down in front of you, dealing 133 to 134 Nature Damage to enemies in a line in front of you and Stunning them for 2 sec.

806599.name: Stormhammer
806599.desc: Stuns the target for 2 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

807105.name: Brine
807105.desc: Generates 25 Static Douse an enemy, dealing 73.659 Frost damage, scaling with your critical strike rating. Scales with modifiers to Shock.

807196.name: Torrential Rage
807196.desc: Increases the damage of Torrential Wrath and Stormflow by 15%.

807233.name: Predictable Weather
807233.desc: Every 30 sec, your next Storm Alert or Torrential Wrath is instant cast.

807314.name: Critical Circuit
807314.desc: Direct critical strikes with Static spenders now refund 10 Static.

807321.name: Unshackle On Spawn Remover (Yeah)
807321.desc: Removes unshackle from the air elemental upon resummon.

807462.name: Aether Mastery
807462.desc: Allows 30% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting and increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

807465.name: Flurry Pet Trigger
807465.desc: The next instance of damage will unleash a Flurry.

807556.name: Flurry Pet Trigger2
807556.desc: Depletes 40 Static Command your Air Elemental to strike an enemy with the force of a thousand gusts of wind, dealing 0 Arcane Damage and increasing the movement speed of all nearby allies by 30% for 15 sec. Scales with modifiers to Call Lightning.

807559.name: Douse
807559.desc: Curse an enemy, reducing all resistances by -87 for 0. Can only have 1 Jinx active on a target at a time.

807657.name: Washed Away
807657.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Drown by -15 sec.

807849.name: Conjure Thunderkeg
807849.desc: Conjures a Thunderkeg in front of you for 3 min. Players in your party or raid may interact with it to receive 5 tankards of Thunderale.

807850.name: Conjure Thunderale
807850.desc: Conjures 5 tankards of Thunderale, providing the Stormbringer and <his/her> allies with something to drink, restoring 6% maximum health and mana every 1 sec for 25 sec. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

808649.name: Leviathan Egg
808649.desc: Summon a baby leviathan to assist you in combat for 20 sec.

850001.name: Volt Static Gain
850001.desc: Fuse lightning into an enemy for -0.001 sec, dealing 0 Nature damage every 0 sec and slowing their movement speed by 1%. Can only affect 1 target at a time. Generates 5 Static per tick.

887004.name: CoA Aura - Stormbringer Class
887004.desc: Tuning aura for Stormbringer Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887034.name: CoA Aura - Stormbringer - Lightning
887034.desc: Tuning aura for Stormbringer - Lightning. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887035.name: CoA Aura - Stormbringer - Wind
887035.desc: Tuning aura for Stormbringer - Wind. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887036.name: CoA Aura - Stormbringer - Maelstrom
887036.desc: Tuning aura for Stormbringer - Maelstrom. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

6801859.name: Pressuring Storms
6801859.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Crackle by 5%.
